name: Standards Folder with Core Standards Library
description: Add a standards/ folder to the FADE structure for modular project standards. Includes five core standards: API Security, Git, Coding, Testing, and Documentation. Each standard is under 1,500 tokens to preserve context window. FADE.md links to standards rather than embedding detail, and prompt.md conditionally loads relevant standards based on work type.

userStories.title: Create standards folder structure
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE, I want a standards/ folder created during fade init so that project standards have a dedicated, organised location
acceptanceCriteria: fade init creates standards/ folder alongside prds/
fade init creates a placeholder README.md in standards/ explaining the folder purpose
Existing projects without standards/ folder continue to work (backwards compatible)

userStories.title: API Security standard document
userStories.description: As a developer building APIs, I want an api-security.md standard so that Claude applies consistent security principles when generating API code
acceptanceCriteria: standards/api-security.md created with Claude-actionable design principles
Covers: auth by default, object-level authz, schema-first, least data returned, rate limits, input validation
Written as instructions Claude can apply, not enterprise governance prose
Each principle has a brief rationale (why it matters)
File is under 1,500 tokens (~1,100 words) to preserve context window

userStories.title: FADE.md template includes Standards section
userStories.description: As a developer, I want FADE.md to link to standards/ so that Claude knows where to find detailed standards without bloating the main context file
acceptanceCriteria: FADE.md template includes '## Standards' section
Section contains markdown links to standards/*.md files
Links use relative paths (standards/api-security.md)
Section includes brief one-liner description per standard

userStories.title: prompt.md references standards for relevant work
userStories.description: As a developer, I want prompt.md to instruct Claude to read relevant standards so that API work triggers reading api-security.md
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md includes instruction to check standards/ folder for relevant context
Specifically: 'When working on API endpoints, read standards/api-security.md first'
General pattern documented for adding new standard references

userStories.title: Git standard document
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a git.md standard so that Claude uses consistent commit messages and branch strategies
acceptanceCriteria: standards/git.md created with commit message format and types
Covers: type prefixes (feat/fix/docs/chore/refactor/test/spike), branch naming, trunk-based vs feature branch rules
Includes FADE-specific conventions (PRD completion commits, spike completion)
File is under 1,500 tokens (~1,100 words) to preserve context window

userStories.title: Coding standard document
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a coding.md standard so that Claude follows consistent formatting, naming, and patterns
acceptanceCriteria: standards/coding.md created with language-agnostic principles
Covers: naming conventions, function/file length limits, error handling, comments, language-specific rules
Includes Do/Don't code examples
File is under 1,500 tokens (~1,100 words) to preserve context window

userStories.title: Testing standard document
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a testing.md standard so that Claude writes tests consistently and doesn't skip coverage
acceptanceCriteria: standards/testing.md created with test philosophy and patterns
Covers: test pyramid, what to test/not test, AAA pattern, naming, mocking guidelines, coverage requirements
Includes examples of good vs bad tests
File is under 1,500 tokens (~1,100 words) to preserve context window

userStories.title: Documentation standard document
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a documentation.md standard so that Claude documents appropriately without over or under documenting
acceptanceCriteria: standards/documentation.md created with documentation layers and guidelines
Covers: what to document, README structure, API docs, ADR format, code comments, FADE-specific docs
Explicitly states what NOT to document (prevents Claude essays)
File is under 1,500 tokens (~1,100 words) to preserve context window

userStories.title: fade update includes standards folder and files
userStories.description: As a developer with an existing FADE project, I want fade update to add the standards folder and files so that I get new standards without manual copying
acceptanceCriteria: fade update creates standards/ folder if missing
fade update copies all standard files (api-security.md, git.md, coding.md, testing.md, documentation.md) if they don't exist locally
fade update does NOT overwrite existing standard files (user may have customised)
fade update reports what was added: 'Added: standards/api-security.md'
Manually verify fade update works by running it on a test project
